description: This Java source file defines the ReferenceController class, which handles web requests related to reference data such as provinces, country names, zone names, credit card expiry years, and months of the year for an e-commerce application. It utilizes Spring MVC annotations for request mapping and interacts with various services to fetch reference data, returning JSON responses.

classes.name: ReferenceController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling reference data related HTTP requests such as fetching provinces, country names, zone names, and credit card expiry dates.

methods.name: getProvinces
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a list of provinces (zones) for a specified country code and language, returning results in JSON format.

methods.name: countryName
methods.description: Fetches the display name of a country given its country code, considering the request's language setting.

methods.name: zoneName
methods.description: Fetches the display name of a zone (region) given its zone code, considering the request's language setting.

methods.name: getCreditCardDates
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of upcoming years (up to 10 years ahead) for credit card expiration date selection.

methods.name: getMonthsOfYear
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of months (1-12 padded with leading zeros) for credit card expiration date selection.
